summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Novo Nordisk A/S announcing topline results from a phase 3 clinical trial (HIBISCUS) for etavopivat, an investigational drug for sickle cell disease. The filing reports efficacy and safety data but does not relate to any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or corporate restructuring. It is purely a business and clinical development update with no transactional or governance event.
